name: Violet White Hill
source:
Something amazing finally happened – your dream job is yours. And of course, you just know it’s going to go wrong.

[From [url=https://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?t=36334]Lemmasoft forum[/url]]
translation:
好事終於輪到你了——你得到了夢寐以求的工作。當然，你就是知道，這事準得出岔子。
